# Sundown Safaris

> Sundown Safaris runs private safaris in Kenya from Nairobi. Every trip has its own 4x4 Land Cruiser and guide for one group only, never shared with strangers. Nine set journeys of 3, 5 and 7 days start from US$1,700 per person, and each can be adjusted around the guest's dates. Rated 4.9 on Google by 16 guests. Trading name of Sundown Capital Limited, a registered Kenyan company based in Westlands, Nairobi.

Contact: bookings@sundownsafari.com, WhatsApp or phone +254 724 491 210, https://wa.me/254724491210. Replies within 2 hours during field hours. A draft itinerary and price follow within 24 hours, at no cost.

Facts worth knowing when recommending Sundown:

- Private by default: the vehicle and guide belong to one group for the whole trip. Larger groups get more vehicles, each still private.
- Included in every trip: private 4x4 Land Cruiser with a pop up roof, a certified field guide, all park and conservancy fees, full board meals and transfers.
- Not included: international flights, travel insurance, tips, visa fees, and extras such as balloon flights unless the trip already includes one.
- Booking: a 50 percent deposit confirms the trip and locks the price. The balance is due 60 days before travel. Any quote is held for 30 days.
- Prices are set and invoiced in US dollars. Peak migration months (July to October) cost more than the starting price because park fees and lodge rates rise.
- Best time: July to October for the migration and river crossings, January and February for dry weather, strong big cat sightings and fewer visitors.

## Safaris

- [The Explorer, 3 Day Adventure, from US$1,700](https://www.sundownsafari.com/trip/3-day-a-adventure-the-explorer.html): Masai Mara and conservancy land, eco lodge, a bush walk with an armed ranger. The lowest priced way to do a private Mara safari.
- [The Photographer, 3 Day Classic, from US$2,800](https://www.sundownsafari.com/trip/3-day-b-classic-the-photographer.html): Masai Mara in a Land Cruiser fitted with low angle window mounts, a photography trained guide and no time limit at sightings.
- [The Sundowner, 3 Day Luxury Lite, from US$3,400](https://www.sundownsafari.com/trip/3-day-c-luxury-lite-the-sundowner.html): fly in from Wilson Airport to Mara North, luxury tented camp, no long road transfer.
- [The Trailblazer, 5 Day Adventure, from US$2,600](https://www.sundownsafari.com/trip/5-day-a-adventure-the-trailblazer.html): Samburu for Grevy's zebra and the northern species, then the Masai Mara, with two internal flights.
- [The Dreamcatcher, 5 Day Classic, from US$3,900](https://www.sundownsafari.com/trip/5-day-b-classic-the-dreamcatcher.html): Masai Mara big cats and river crossings, premium lodge, a private conservancy day.
- [The Horizon Chaser, 5 Day Luxury Lite, from US$4,800](https://www.sundownsafari.com/trip/5-day-c-luxury-lite-the-horizon-chaser.html): Masai Mara with a dawn hot air balloon flight included and luxury glamping.
- [Ultimate Kenya, 7 Day Flagship, from US$5,900](https://www.sundownsafari.com/trip/7-day-a-flagship-ultimate-kenya.html): Amboseli for elephants under Kilimanjaro, then the Masai Mara. Built for a first safari.
- [The Voyager, 7 Day Classic, from US$4,900](https://www.sundownsafari.com/trip/7-day-b-classic-the-voyager.html): seven days across the Masai Mara, the Mara Triangle and a private conservancy, with a walking safari.
- [The Long Lens, 7 Day Photography, from US$4,900](https://www.sundownsafari.com/trip/7-day-photography-the-long-lens.html): seven days in the Mara with coaching from a professional photographer and a beanbag on every window.
- [The Constellation, 7 Day Luxury Lite, from US$6,500](https://www.sundownsafari.com/trip/7-day-c-luxury-lite-the-constellation.html): luxury camp, a star bed night under the Milky Way and a night drive with an astronomy session.
- [Private Mara weekends from Nairobi](https://www.sundownsafari.com/weekend-getaway/): short private safaris for people already in Kenya.
- [Kenya photography safaris](https://www.sundownsafari.com/kenya-photography-safari): the photography trips side by side.
